d: When Gurmeet Singh first became the leader of Dera Sacha Sauda, nobody expected this young outsider to rise so quickly or hold so much power. But what followed is one of the wildest stories ever seen in India: a godman who built a cult empire, controlled politicians, and walked in and out of jail even after being convicted for rape and murder. This video uncovers the unbelievable journey of Gurmeet Ram Rahim, the secrets inside his dera, and why justice in his case still feels like a work in progress.
